description: C1 infinity step 2 (bean qou-odh5). q-Gevrey order of the C1 solutions is 1/2, matching the Newton-polygon slope 1/2 found independently in step 1. The level-1/2 q-Borel transform has finite radius ~ q^8.2526. Ratio-test limits converge to 10 digits within a branch but differ between branches at 3.7e-4, indicating TWO nearby singularities — the sector structure predicted by the leading blocks B = +/- sqrt(q-1)/q. Stokes multipliers NOT extracted.

results.interpretation: branch-dependent ratio limit => two nearby singularities, not one simple pole; consistent with the two sectors from B = +/- sqrt(q-1)/q
